description: This source file defines the TimesheetActionLogAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for retrieving timesheet action logs in the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for fetching logs associated with a specific timesheet, handles pagination and sorting, and integrates permission checks.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint providing access to timesheet action logs, supporting retrieval with sorting and pagination, with role-based access control.
